book.name: LIPE ORA SIRIMU
book.title: LIPE ORA SIRIMU Pe Wendo Ombá Mele Kirasini Jono Ou LIPE ORA SIRIMU Bokumu

content: Ou akumu kanopolie nirindumuni, pe altopo kanorundu kinie angello te mulu koleana manie orumu. Akumu yu kolea nokomba namba paa awili te mondopa, yunge tondolo pa telimuni ma koleana pa tenderimu.
Yuni paa tondolo ru nimbelie nimbendo:

content.text: “Kolea Awili Imbi Paa Olandopa Mololi Bepillono
kamu keri liemu. Keri lepa pora simu.
⸤Ou yembo awisili akune moloringi nalo kinié⸥

content: ‘Kanu koleana yembo moloringimene

content.text: wa ulu kerinele tenge ulume pelemo no-waene
karaye terimu noringimunge kamu keri lierimu.
Koleamanga pali ye nomi kingimene kepe
kara puku mele kerime waka lierimumunge

content: nirimu.
Kanu kinie pe mulu koleana ungu te lupe wendo orumu pilierindu kinie nimbendo:

content.text: eno aku koleamo munduku siye kolko ulsu wangi.
Ulu pulu keri telemo akumenga Pulu Yemone
umbune simbema olio pea naa liemili.’ ningu

content: Yuni yando tepa kenjerimu akumunge

content.text: enone anjo aku siku yu pundu toko siengi.
enone anjo tere leko pundu tangi.
Yuni no enge nili mingi kapona
tepa mimi terimumu liku tere leko
no enge nili olandopa pulimu yu nopili siengi.

content: Yu yuyu ou ‘molopo kondambo.’ nimbe

content.text: yunge imbi lipe ola mundupe kara pupe molorumu
akumunge pundu toko yu mindili siku
‘Na ambo nomi kuwini molopo kuwininge polona molio.
Na walsikele kepe kola tepo kola-ulke naa molombo.’

content: Akumunge ena telumunge

content.text: yunge umbune wendo ombáma wendo ombá.
Yembo kolonge kuru awisili wendo omba,
yembo awisili kola teko, kolea engele lemba.
Yuni ulume aku sipe tepa kenjimbemonga
yu kote tendepa pilimo Pulu Ye Awilimu
paa enge nili olandopa pelemo yemone

content: “Yu-kinie wa ulu kerinele teko, yu waka kolorumu ulume pea waka koloringi kara puku teringi ye nomi kingimene yu tepene nomba ilie wendo ombá kinie kanokolie kola teko kola-ulkena wale awisili molonge.
Yu mindili nombá mele kanokolie paa mini-wale munduku paa sulu teko angilkulie ningendo:

content.text: “Ai ya! Ai ya! Kolea imbi paa ola mololimu,
kolea paa awili enge nili Bepillono!

content: “Mana bisinete tenge yema enonga bisinete teko kou mone linge melema naa lingemonga eno kola teko wale awisili kola-ulke molonge.

Bisinete teko nosinge mele akume isipe: Kou-gollo kinie kou-sillipa kinie umbu kou kou mone awili tepa pulimoma kinie siripelu kake kou mone paa olandopa pulimoma kinie; múlu kake peangama kinie, múlu kondoli lupe lupema kinie; unjo lupe lupe mune tolime kinie, mele lupe lupe kongi ellepene ungúni teko mimi tenge melema kinie, unjo kou mone awili tepa pulimene teko mimi tenge melema kinie, kou-boronisi kinie kou-aini kinie kou mono-wape teli kinie aku koumene teko mimi tenge melema kinie, aku melema nosiku,

kangine ‘mune topili.’ ningu kopongo-wele teko mimi teko kalemele sinamono kinie sipási kinie, paura keku kalemele kinie mune tolemoma kinie, wele lupe lupe mune tolime kinie, no-waene kinie unjo-ollipi wele kinie, rasi-witi kinie, rasi-witimuni teko mimi telemele pillawa kinie; kongi kao sipisipime kinie; kongi ote kinie otene kundulimo karoma kinie; kongono we tendenge kendemande molonge yembo, ‘konopu naa pepa kongi mele molemele.’ ningu mengo puku kou-mone bisinete tenge yemboma kinie; aku mele nosingema pali yembomane altoko koleamanga lupe liku mengo ongo makete teko kou linge aulkemo manie pumbemonga kola tenge.

“Enone ningendo: ‘Nu mele peanga kou mone olandopa pulimo melema ‘paa liemboa!’ konopu lenoma manie pumu. Mele peanga kande kandema nu waka liemume kinie nunge anilino mele kou mone olandopa pulimo peangama kinie kamu-kumu nu mundupe siye kolopa manie pumu. Melema altopa nu-kinie naa lemba kanoni.’ ninge.
Aku melema bisinete teko kou mone awisili liku singe yemane sulu teko angilku yu mindili awili tepa nombá mele kanokolie paa mini-wale mundunge. Kola teko kola-ulke molkolie
ru ningulie ningendo:

content.text: “Ai ya! Ai ya! Kolea imbi paa ola mololimu,
kou-gollo kinie kou kangi lupe-lupe kololi
kou mone awili tepa pulimoma kinie,
kou mone awili tepa pulimoma kinie

content: Ena mongo telumunge yuni kou mone
“Nomu-kusana andoli sipi nokolemele yema kinie sipimenga kongono telemele yema kinie nona andoko bisinete teko kou mone limele yemboma kinie aulke sulu teko angilkulie kanonge.
Tepe nombámonga iliemo kanokolie ningendo: “I kolea awilimu none teli te lierimuye?” ninge.
Ma kungupu liku pakoko
kola teko kola-ulke molkolie ningemone ru ningulie ningendo:

content.text: “Ai ya! Ai ya! Kolea imbi paa ola mololimu,
akune kou mone awili tepa noserimu
kou mone awili teko lsingi koleamo!
aku koleamo kamu keri liemu.” ninge.

content: “Mulu koleana molemele yemboma kinie,

content.text: Pulu Yemone ungu umbu tondorumume pilku
ikoleamone eno mindili sipe tepa kenjerimumunge

content: nimbé.
Kanu kinie angello paa enge nili tene kou paa awili te
ola lipe nomu-kusana topa manie mundupelie nimbendo:

content.text: kolea awili imbi paa ola mololi kolea Bepillono

content: Gita toko, kolape-mingi langoko,

content.text: Ulke takoko mele teko mimi telemele kongonomanga
rasi-witi kali lemele kinie ungu nilimo ungumu
altopa kamu-kumu naa nimbé naa pilinge.

content: Nu koleamo kamu-kumu tepe-llame pa naa temba.

content.text: Ye te ambo limbe molo ambo te ye pumbendo
nu koleamo altoko kamu-kumu naa pilinge.
kolo toko kondi toko sirinu akumuni

content: Pulu Yemone ungu umbu tondorumu ungume pilku

content.text: ma koleamanga pali toko kondoringi yembomanga

content: nirimu.

footnotes.text: Umbu yemboma kola-ulke pungendo oli-kamó kalko pakolemele mele.
‘Pillawa teamili.’ ningu rasi-witi kali lemele kou awili melemo. Pikisana kongi dongini kundupe mepa andorumu mele. Pikisa te gomo 97 molemo kananila.
